test=[[8,8,8,0,3,5,0,5,5,3,9,0,0,0,3,0,0,0,0],[8,0,8,8,3,5,5,5,5,3,0,0,9,9,3,4,4,0,4],[8,0,0,8,3,5,0,5,5,3,0,0,0,9,3,0,4,0,4],[0,0,8,8,3,0,0,5,5,3,9,9,9,0,3,0,4,4,0]]
def transform(grid):
    # The four 4x4 panels are overlaid, with the observed front-to-back priority.
    priority=(9,4,8,5)
    starts=(0,5,10,15)
    return [[next((color for color in priority if any(grid[r][s+c]==color for s in starts)),0) for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]
demo_out=[[9,9,9,4],[9,9,8,9],[5,4,4,8],[9,4,4,4]]

print('demo:', transform(demo_in), transform(demo_in)==demo_out)
print('test:',transform(test))
